_comment: Force AUX as the default source. Two halves: (1) `media.settings` edits the seed database inside system.bin, and (2) `user_data` ships that database as the NAV/USER_DATA payload, because that is where the unit actually reads its live settings - system.bin extracts to the read-only /SYSTEM/, so editing it alone changes nothing (confirmed on the car: still booted to FM). user_data ships ONLY up_common.sqlite, deliberately, so the unit's other personal state is left as alone as this mechanism allows. LOCAL build manifest - the paths below are absolute for one checkout, so edit them before reusing. Force AUX as the default source. Step 1 of the plan in issue #72: a DATA edit only, so there is no code patch and nothing can be bricked. `supervisor.Last_Source` is the value C_MGR_SRC::StartUp() restores at boot (saved by C_MGR_SRC::ImmediateSourceSave()). AUX is position 4 per the 0-based source list in C_HMI_AUDIO_APP_BASE::GetSourceAtPosition(). If the unit ignores it, try varying supervisor.Last_Source_Priority (currently 1) alongside it. If 4 lands on the WRONG source, the position guess is wrong - report what it did land on and it can be corrected from a single flash rather than a guess.
